role: Announce Tally as an intake layer for client automations
subject: Meet Tally for client workflows
preview_text: Send form submissions as structured JSON to an HTTP endpoint in real time.
headline: Start client workflows with a Tally form
body:
Tally has launched as an online form builder for more than collecting answers. It can give an automated client workflow a clear, form-based starting point.

For custom routes, a Tally webhook can send every submission as structured JSON to an HTTP endpoint in real time. Your workflow can take it from there.

Tally can also trigger Make, Zapier, or n8n, which can route that data to CRMs, billing tools, internal databases, or messaging apps.

That makes Tally worth considering as the intake layer for an upcoming client build. The form builder gives you a concrete source to evaluate against the exact route and field mapping your workflow needs.
